Update a tree from the server

Source: R/tree.R
update_shad_tree.Rd

Update a tree from the server

Usage

update_shad_tree(
  id,
  selected = NULL,
  expanded = NULL,
  children = NULL,
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
)

Arguments

id

Input id (namespaced automatically).

selected

Optional character vector of keys to select.

expanded

Optional named list mapping keys to logicals (expand/collapse).

children

Optional list list(value = <parent key>, items = <tagList of [shad_tree_item()]>) to fill a lazy branch (an empty items marks it a leaf).

session

The Shiny session.

Value

Invisibly NULL.

See also

Other shadshiny flow: shad_dropzone(), shad_number_input(), shad_rating(), shad_step(), shad_stepper(), shad_tree(), shad_tree_item(), update_shad_number_input(), update_shad_rating(), update_shad_stepper()

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  ui <- page_shad(
    shad_tree("files", shad_tree_item("data", "data", lazy = TRUE))
  )
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    # A lazy branch asks for its children the first time it opens.
    shiny::observeEvent(input$files_expanded, {
      event <- input$files_expanded
      if (identical(event$key, "data") && isTRUE(event$expanded)) {
        update_shad_tree("files", children = list(
          value = "data",
          items = htmltools::tagList(
            shad_tree_item("data/a.csv", "a.csv"),
            shad_tree_item("data/b.csv", "b.csv")
          )
        ))
      }
    })
  }
  shiny::shinyApp(ui, server)
}
